bad_pattern: Rendering global wallet/payout links inside course or document sub-sidebars.
correct_pattern: Strict contextual isolation: sub-resource sidebars contain only local navigation items.
rationale: Prevents context bleeding between tenant/course workspaces and global platform administration.

bad_pattern: position: absolute; right: 10px; top: 10px; on action buttons over text titles.
correct_pattern: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
rationale: Absolute action buttons collide with dynamic text titles on responsive viewports.

bad_pattern: Hardcoding top-level navigation bars with un-scoped position: fixed.
correct_pattern: Use position: sticky; top: 0 with proper z-index elevation and flex margin flow.
rationale: Un-scoped fixed headers clip sub-route content and overlap modal overlays.

bad_pattern: Relying solely on frontend UI role state without verifying auth.uid() at database/API tier.
correct_pattern: Enforce Three-Tier Defensive Boundaries with PostgreSQL RLS checking auth.uid() directly.
rationale: Prevents unauthorized users from bypassing client UI to invoke backend state mutations.

bad_pattern: Awaiting external LLM requests without an AbortController or fallback mock state.
correct_pattern: Enforce a 5-second timeout via AbortController with deterministic fallback mock UI returns.
rationale: Eliminates application hangs and infinite modal loading states during provider outages.

bad_pattern: Writing raw CREATE TABLE or CREATE INDEX statements without existence checks.
correct_pattern: Always use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.
rationale: Ensures migration scripts can be safely re-run across test, staging, and production environments.
